[[Containment]] |sandbox = Yes |rewards_increase = None }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|It's actually just pizza sauce!|In-Game Description}} }} ==Description== '''Blood''' is a cosmetic [[Modifiers|modifier]]. When enemies die, it causes them to splatter blood (or, according to the description, pizza sauce). '''Blood''' is active on all matches in [[Pizza Party]], [[Failed Gateway]], [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]]. ==Effects== When active, the '''Blood''' modifier adds a death effect when an enemy dies, in which blood is splattered onto the map. This blood is purely visual and does not affect gameplay. The blood remains on the map for around a minute before shrinking and despawning. If an enemy, such as the [[Scout (Pizza Party)|Scout]] or [[Shotgunner (Pizza Party)|Shotgunner]], has a death animation, blood will appear once the enemy actually disappears. If a player's age is 13 or over, the blood is red. If a player is under the age of 13, blood is green. ==Update History== *'''31 October 2022''' - [[v1.4.2]] **'''Blood''' added. *'''23 October 2024''' - [[v1.37.0]] **Updated blood effects. **'''Blood''' is now active in [[Failed Gateway]]. *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Blood''' is now active in [[The Nightmare Realm]]. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Blood''' is now active in [[Containment]]. {{ModifierNavBox}}
